exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 90 women (45 with elective cesarean delivery and 45 with vaginal delivery) who delivered at a public hospital in Tehran, Iran
finding: While there were no significant differences in quality of life or marital satisfaction between groups at 12 weeks postpartum, women with vaginal deliveries had significantly higher omentin-1 levels 24 hours after delivery.
mod_finding: Women who had vaginal deliveries had higher omentin-1 levels than those who had cesarean sections.
